description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small" illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) over a series of epochs for different configurations of the Whisper model. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model. The first line, marked with circles and a solid line, represents the "small AdaLoRA_int4" configuration, starting at a WER of approximately 30.0 and ending at around 30.0. The second line, marked with squares and a dashed line, represents the "small AdaLoRA_int8" configuration, starting at a WER of approximately 35.0 and ending at around 30.0. The third line, marked with circles and a dash-dot line, represents the "small int4" configuration, starting at a WER of approximately 30.0 and ending at around 25.0. The fourth line, marked with squares and a solid line, represents the "small int8" configuration, starting at a WER of approximately 35.0 and ending at around 25.0. The plot shows that the "small int4" and "small int8" configurations have the lowest WERs across the epochs, while the "small AdaLoRA_int4" and "small AdaLoRA_int8" configurations have higher WERs.
